sources: Donald Trump remarks departing White House for Iowa (verbatim via CNN, Al Jazeera liveblog); CNN analysis piece; ANI wire relay (ET/Republic/Lokmat)
fault_line: Finish the job vs forever war: does striking Iran again end the threat, or drag America into another endless conflict? Fault line also runs inside Trump's own base — Iowa GOP voters are wary even as some demand decisive

sections.what_happened: Trump, asked about the war's effect on midterm voters: 'The Iran war — and we've knocked the hell out of them, and we may do it a little bit further.' CNN's fresh Iowa piece adds: Iowa GOP voters wary as the war proves unpopular even among Trump supporters; high gas/diesel prices hurt farmers; GOP Senate nominee Ashley Hinson (appearing with Trump Thursday) voted against a House resolution limiting Trump's war powers but calls the war 'too expensive' and wants a 'successful and immediate end'; two Iowa soldiers killed at the conflict's start — Maj. Jeffrey O'Brien (Indianola) and Sgt. Declan Coady (West Des Moines), 103rd Sustainment Command, in an Iranian drone strike on a tactical operations center in Kuwait. Officials tell CNN one option under active consideration: the 22,000-pound GBU-43/B Massive Ordnance Air Blast ('Mother of All Bombs') against Iran's deeply buried Pickaxe Mountain nuclear facility; behind the scenes advisers drew up post-midterm strike plans with Israel that could execute 'as soon as Trump gives the go-ahead.' Trump still rules out strikes before Election Day.
sections.what_verified: Trump verbatim quote corroborated by Al Jazeera liveblog (20:46 GMT entry), anewz (Reuters), timesnownews liveblog. MOAB-under-consideration relayed by ANI wire (ET, Republic World, Lokmat): 'reports that US President Donald Trump has considered using the 22,000-pound GBU-43/B MOAB against Iran's deeply buried Pickaxe Mountain nuclear facility.' Hinson voting record/stance is on-record campaign material. O'Brien/Coady names via mezha.net Iowa piece.
sections.what_disputed: No guarantee Trump approves new strikes — CNN notes he has 'previously backed off when he seemed close to ordering a new onslaught'; he publicly ruled out pre-election strikes (Oct 8 Truth Social). MOAB effectiveness against a deeply buried fortified site is questioned by experts cited in the ANI relay. Distinguish from the recycled Newsmax/Finnerty clip caption claiming 'TRUMP CONFIRMS HE'S DROPPING THE MOTHER OF ALL BOMBS' — that caption is alarmist editorializing, NOT verified (see DNP record).
sections.why_matters: Trump tells his own voters he may escalate while their gas prices bite — the split inside MAGA over the Iran war. Our angle stays with the record: voters pay the price (Iowa farmers, $100 WTI) while war planners pick the date after the election. No cheerleading for either side; show the named dead (O'Brien, Coady) and the MOAB option exactly as reported.
sections.context: Background: CAUGHT-UP: Trump says US 'may do it a little bit further' on Iran — fresh CNN Iowa piece: GOP base wary, MOAB (GBU-43/B) option under consideration for Pickaxe Mountain, 2 named Iowa soldiers killed
